name: Arriving Text
description: A passage that arrives word by word, each word rising slightly and coming into focus.

props.name: text
props.description: The passage. A line break starts a new line. Screen readers get the whole passage at once.

props.name: by
props.description: What arrives together: each word, each character, or each line as the passage wraps.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between one unit and the next.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each unit takes to rise and come into focus.

props.name: blur
props.description: Units come into focus from a blur. Off, they only rise and fade in.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the passage is scrolled into view, then run once. Off, it runs on mount.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the element. Font, size and colour are inherited. Under reduced motion the passage shows at once.
